Thanks for sending the W-9 and the authorization scan. Two quick items so we can move procurement forward:

- Remote notarization/video (we can accept a short recorded session + notary stamp)
- DocuSign notarized affidavit (DocuSign link works if signed by authorized officer)
- KBA flow (ID + short KB questions) — generally takes 15–30 minutes.

I pasted the procurement portal intake link here for the DocuSign/KBA route: https://redwood.app/procurement/onboard. If you can confirm which route you prefer I’ll kick off a provisional PO in the meantime and loop AP to the payment schedule.
